# Alice Tran Psychiatric Care

> Board-certified psychiatric care for adults ages 18 to 65, in person in Fairfax, Virginia and by telehealth across all of Virginia, in English and Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt). Alice Tran is a dual board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) and Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP-BC), trained under psychiatrist Dr. Errol Segall, MD (50+ years of experience).

Key facts:
- Services: psychiatric evaluations, medication management, supportive therapy
- Conditions treated: anxiety, depression, ADHD, bipolar disorder, PTSD and trauma, OCD, panic disorder, insomnia, burnout, postpartum and perinatal mood, and more
- Location: 3060 Williams Drive, Suite 300, Fairfax, VA 22031 (free parking); telehealth available anywhere in Virginia
- Languages: English and Vietnamese; full evaluations and follow-ups conducted in Vietnamese with no interpreter
- Insurance: most major plans accepted, including Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, Medicare, and Medicaid
- Self-pay pricing: initial psychiatric evaluation $400; follow-ups $200 (30 min) or $250 (45 min)
- Hours: Monday through Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern
- New patients: typically seen within one to two weeks; no referral needed
- Booking: https://alicetran.intakeq.com/booking or call/text (703) 791-9099
- Not a crisis service: for emergencies call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline)
